However, on all future occasions, as and when required, the petitioner shall meet the Investigating Officer and provide all necessary information and documents.
3. Mr. Edulji has submitted that the petitioner has manipulated and forged the documents and all necessary documents have been shared with the Investigating Officer.
4. Mr. Sengupta has submitted that there are incriminating materials which, prima facie, would show that money has reached the hands of the relatives of the present petitioner.
5. However, before we decide this application for anticipatory bail, we feel that the petitioner shall produce all the relevant documents before the Investigating Agency.

6. The petitioner shall meet the Investigating Officer on the date and time to be duly intimated to the petitioner by the Investigating Officer and shall produce all necessary documents as may be asked for by the Investigating Officer for proper investigation and shall cooperate with the investigation.
7.
Subject to such compliance, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner till 11th November, 2024.
8. The matter shall be listed on 5th November, 2024.
9. The written note filed on behalf of the de facto complainant is taken on record.
